Parents may arrange for their children to be nursed by whoever is willing. A mother may say: "I will nurse him, my brother, for I am satisfied." chapters.source_excerpt: On charity and spending in the way of God: "The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a grain that sprouts seven ears, each ear containing a hundred grains. And Allah multiplies for whom He wills, and Allah is Vast and Knowing."
